identity: A Nahda-era Arabic magazine essay headed الموسيقى (Music), almost certainly early 20th century. Register: formal belletristic expository prose — a lecture-essay, not narrative and not memoir. It opens by canvassing how العلماء, الشعراء and علماء النفس البسيكولوجيين define music; gives a worked example of intonation on the single word الله across three scenarios; catalogues music's effects on the nervous, the insane in بيماراستانات أوروبا, horses, camels and snakes (with an embedded French gloss Charmeurs de serpents and the pipe تومريل); cites لوثير, بيتهوفن and فاجنر; adduces the harp carving found by المسيو سرزيك at قصر تللو dated by بواتييه to thirty centuries BC; and closes with an enumeration of music's links to the sciences. 644 tokens, 16 <NL> tokens, 17 paragraphs (the first is the one-word title).
law: Doctrine register bucket §B/§L/§I (encyclopedic-expository / belles-lettres essay), NOT §H memoir — so LAW 1 runs at full strength and my old welding default is switched off. Target sentence ~11-15 tokens; 628 content tokens over 57 boundaries gives 11.0, which is deliberately on the dense side of the band because LAW 0 records a 4.8:1 under-cutting base rate and prices a miss at ~5x a false cut. Operative rules, in the order they fired here: (1) LAW 1 — و + a finite clause carrying a NEW argument (new subject NP, new topic NP, new object) is a new sentence: وأقدم دليل, وعثر عليها المسيو سرزيك, وقد قرر تاريخها أفاضل العلماء, ولا مشاحة, ويتسنى طرق أبوابها, وفضلها, وترتبط/وتتعلق x3, وتستعمل في بيماراستانات أوروبا, ويوقعون عليه ألحانا خاصة, وما الموسيقى إلا لغته الفنية, وبها ندرك. (2) The LAW 1 exemption fires just as hard: phrase-level و joining nouns/adjectives/bare VPs adds no argument and NEVER cuts — the four-member predicate series غذاء الأفئدة ومهذبة النفوس ومفرجة الكروب ومسكنة الآلام, the comparative chain أفصح من النطق وأبلغ من البيان وأقرب منهما, the arts list كالشعر والموسيقى والتصوير والحفر والتمثيل والرقص, the object chain تقدمها وما صادفها وعلاقاتها ودورها, and every two-verb chain (وتقف, ونطيل, وتخاطب, وكشفا, ويسيل). (3) إذ (causal) opens a segment — §C3/§B2 — fired four times: @182, @233, @291, @579. (4) LAW 2 — ف opening a new narrative/explanatory step with a new overt subject cuts (فتهرع إليهم الثعابين, فيأخذها الطرب, فيحدوها سائقها, فيصفر لها راعيها, فإذا سمعوها, فإن كانا مزودين); but §B4's short result-ف is a TAIL and welds (فأصبحت كأنها من لوازم الحياة, فتنفحهم مقرا رفيعا, فتلعب وترقص, فتطمئن وتشرب). (5) §C1 — a conditional period is ONE unit, protasis plus apodosis; the cut goes before the next وإذا/وإن (@127, @156, @494) and never between shart and jawab. (6) LAW 3 / §G2 — a comma-set appositive that renames cuts (تلك الهوام الخبيثة, عالم المعرفة, the Latin gloss). (7) §G1 — a speech verb welds to the utterance it introduces, so no cut at the colon after وقال بيتهوفن / وقال فاجنر / وقال غيره; the sole exception is لوثير, where a parenthetical intervenes between verb and quote and therefore takes a boundary on each side (§B5). Long quotations are then segmented internally as ordinary prose, since a 44-token citation obviously carried its own full stops. Every <NL> is preceded by a boundary and no <NL> carries one.
reasoning: SITES I ARGUED. @14 الأسماع, before أو قالوا لنا: أو is not covered by my doctrine, but قالوا is a fresh finite matrix verb with its own arguments (لنا, إنها فن الأصوات), so it passes the LAW 1 argument test even though the connector is not و; splitting 23 tokens into 13+10 also matches the register. Cut, lo. @81 تاما, before وأن الموسيقى وحدها: DECLINED — وأن is a coordinated complementizer under اتفق على with no matrix verb of its own; cutting would strand a dangling أن-complement. This is the deliberate contrast with @14 and keeps the two decisions consistent. @48/@59: DECLINED, nominal and adjectival coordination inside one أنّ-clause; §B5's precedent shows the gold cuts at the edge of a list, never inside it. P5 (the الله example, 65 tokens): the three scenarios are rhetorically parallel, and (b) وإذا فاجأت طفلك and (c) وإن فاجأك أحد are each single conditional periods of 29 and 16 tokens. So I refused to shred (a) into 3+6+11 the way an isolated reading of LAW 2 would want; I took only @119 الله, where (a) alone acquires an extra finite clause chain ونلفظها … ونطيل that (b) and (c) lack, and let the two result-ف joints @110/@116 ride. Cuts at @127 and @156 are the boundaries between scenarios and are free. @148 وفتح هاء الأولى: DECLINED, because its exact structural twin @171 وحاذفا المد is an unarguable coordinated hal participle — the parallelism forces both to weld or both to cut, and the second cannot cut. @178: DECLINED; two asyndetic predications but no repetition, so LAW 3's discriminator says mere sequence, do not cut. @206 وجلبت لهم نعاسا هنيئا: DECLINED — inside the jawab of فإذا سمعوها, and shaped like وأكل خبزا in the doctrine's فجلس وأكل خبزا وشرب ماء, which is one segment. @214 فيهرع إليها المجانين: DECLINED after going back and forth. It is structurally the twin of @199-@210 (statement of use, then effect) which I am keeping whole, and §B4 has four logged false cuts of mine on exactly this short-result-ف shape; P6 was already at 9.8 tokens per segment without it. @229 بل هيمن على الحيوان: DECLINED — بل is the second limb of لم يقتصر … بل, one syntactic unit. Same ruling at @390 (إن هي إلا رحيق … بل هي الحياة) and @432 (وما الموسيقى إلا لغته … بل الهوى): all three are negative-restrictive plus corrective بل, a correlative that cannot be split. P7/P8 are near-identical camel/horse vignettes of 26 tokens each and I forced them to agree: cut before the ف that introduces the NEW human agent (@244 فيصفر لها راعيها, @264 فيحدوها سائقها) and weld the short ف that returns to the animal (@247, @268), and no cut at @260 since فتتثاقل is the jawab of حينما. @299/@302 (Charmeurs de serpents): my weakest pair. §B5 says a set-off parenthetical takes two boundaries, not zero, and §G2 says an appositive rename cuts before it; a Latin-script run embedded in Arabic is the kind of foreign object §A shows this annotation isolating. But §A2's only stated law is about dots, and there is no dot here. I took both at lo confidence purely on LAW 0's 5:1 asymmetry — if wrong it costs two precision points, if right it buys two recall points. @308 وهو خاص بالثعابين: DECLINED. §L flags وهي-appositive continuations as a gold cut and I nearly took it, but read as ink the comma falls AFTER بالثعابين, not before وهو — the hal clause closes the مزمار description and the boundary belongs at @311 where ويوقعون restarts the predication with a new object. @320 وتقف بين أيديهم: DECLINED, two-verb chain on الثعابين. @357/@360 (Luther): taken as a pair or not at all. §G1 is my strongest evidence class (five logged false cuts) and says a speech verb welds to its quote — so I refused the colon at @374, @424 and @442. Luther is the one place where وكان موسيقيا فاضلا sits BETWEEN the verb and the quote; a comma-set parenthetical takes a boundary on each side or neither, and gluing a parenthetical to a quotation is a shape no punctuation reconstruction produces. Both lo. @382 والفلسفة: inside the Beethoven quote, asyndetic juxtaposition of two full predications with the topic restated — a period in the original; a 44-token citation cannot be one segment. @404 العالى: comma-set appositive rename, §G2, lo. @516 وجدت في بلاد الكلدانيين: DECLINED — once @520 (وعثر عليها + the new overt subject المسيو سرزيك, the canonical LAW 1 cut) is taken, the surrounding segments come out at 19 and 15 tokens and no further cut is needed. @478 فأصبحت and @634 فتنفحهم: DECLINED, §B4 short result-ف tails, the second one additionally inside an أن-complement. @583 فإن كانا مزودين: taken — LAW 2 lists فإنه/فإن among the explanatory openers and §C1 gives a conditional period its own sentence. The closing enumeration وترتبط … وتتعلق … وترتبط is LAW 1 plus LAW 3 parallelism and is the most confident run in the document.
